text:
Maria F: FYI HelioMed flagged this invoice as wrong — they say committed capacity and platform fee lines don't match the signed SOW. Can someone check before I reply?
Tomas A: I talked to them briefly, they upgraded support mid-term and expected platform fee proration. They got charged full platform fee plus a separate commit add-on.
Rebecca S: Sending the invoice snippet I pulled from billing system:
```
Invoice 2026-HE-7192
Line 1: ONPREM_COMMIT_MONTHLY  x1  USD 45,000
Line 2: PLATFORM_FEE_VPC        x1  USD 12,000
Line 3: SUPPORT_TIER_T3         x1  USD 8,000
Line 4: SUPPORT_TIER_ADJ (prorate) x1  USD 0
```
They claim support should've moved to T2 on 2026-02-10 and platform fee should be prorated from T2 rate (USD 6,000/mo).
Maria F: Hmm, our metering shows the commit was active, but the signed SOW has an addendum that reduced platform fee on the downgrade — looks like the addendum didn't carry to invoicing.
BillingBot: Reconciliation check complete for invoice 2026-HE-7192 — mismatch detected: contract_reference HE-SOW-2026-A addendum present but not applied to platform_fee line. Ticket BILL-4591 opened.
Ollie R: Thanks bot. Maria — do we have a precedence for issuing a proforma adjustment vs immediate credit?
Maria F: For enterprise customers we prefer a proforma adjustment and apply a one-time credit on next billing cycle unless they need immediate cash refund.
Tomas A: HelioMed wants an adjusted invoice for their AP team; they'll accept a credit if we send a corrected proforma.
Ajay K: Legal signoff: confirmed addendum is valid and retroactive to 2026-02-10. No objections to proforma correction.
Rebecca S: I'll prepare the corrected lines and calculate proration. Proposed corrected invoice:
```
Line 1: ONPREM_COMMIT_MONTHLY  x1  USD 45,000
Line 2: PLATFORM_FEE_VPC (prorated T3->T2) USD -3,000
Line 3: PLATFORM_FEE_ADJUSTMENT CREDIT    USD -6,000
Line 4: SUPPORT_TIER_T2 (effective 2026-02-10) USD 4,000
```
Net adjustment: USD -5,000 credit.
Maria F: Please attach the SOW addendum and approval note. Ollie pls confirm accounting code for credit (should go to 4-REV-PlatformCredits).
Ollie R: Confirmed accounting code 4-REV-PlatformCredits. Also mark this as "private-deploy trueup" in the ledger so we can trace.
Tomas A: I'll inform HelioMed we will issue a corrected proforma and post a credit to their next invoice. Tagging them now. @HelioMed-AP: we detected an invoicing mistake and will send corrected proforma within 48 hours.
Maria F: Final step — I need a finance approval thread note. Approving: Maria F (Finance) 2026-03-14 09:12 PT. Ollie?
Ollie R: Approving: Ollie R (Rev Ops) 2026-03-14 09:18 PT.
BillingBot: Proforma 2026-PRO-081 generated and queued for send to HelioMed-AP. Credit memo CM-2026-HE-009 created against invoice 2026-HE-7192 for USD 5,000.
Rebecca S: Done — proforma sent, attached SOW addendum and ledger note.
Tomas A: HelioMed confirms receipt and will accept credit, closing on their side. :thumbsup:
Maria F: Great — closing thread. I'll log the incident in BILL-4591 as "resolved - proforma issued & credit applied".
BillingBot: Ticket BILL-4591 updated to RESOLVED."
